theorem profileStress_lower_bound {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε c : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < c ∧ ∀ η ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < ε →
        c * FlatCutoff.edge 4 x / x ^ 3 ≤ ‖profileStress C d y0 (η, x)‖
